uiChecks.scope: Browser UI exercised on development and production builds. Orbit drag, downloads and 1920x1080 lab run were not automated; interactive relief rendering and export report data were inspected.

observations.interpretation: High decoded accuracy coexists with chromatic disagreement. Quiet limits eye-color conflict but a local color edit propagates farther. These support distinct engineering diagnoses, not a perceptual equivalence claim.

boundaries: The observer imports no renderer/encoder or truth data; evaluation introduces ground truth after matching.
Thresholds are heuristic, versioned and not trained against a human comfort dataset.
Known human-rejected and negative profiles cannot appear on the candidate frontier.
Screen-space frame change includes intended motion; jitter subtracts intended disparity change but is not optical flow.
Relief interpolates confident nearby reconstructed samples; missing regions stay missing.
Existing gameplay and external Firefox results remain historical; this update did not reverify captured mouse/fullscreen or change the gameplay renderer.
